# KaizenLabAI

> AI experiments. A little better every day.

KaizenLabAI is an AI lab applying kaizen (continuous, incremental improvement) to building with AI. We are pre-launch and building in stealth.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.kaizenlabai.com/): the lab. The logo opens a remote with interactive tools (listed below).
- [Learning](https://www.kaizenlabai.com/learning/): educational AI videos from our YouTube channel. First video: "21 Layers from the Edge of the Universe" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=diDHi31MHFA)
- [Agents](https://www.kaizenlabai.com/agents/): AI workers (coming soon)
- [Open Source](https://www.kaizenlabai.com/open-source/): code from the lab, open for anyone to use (GitHub: https://github.com/jeffreyaifudenna)
- [Bots](https://www.kaizenlabai.com/bots/): live counts of self-identified bots (AI, search, social) that visited this site, from our own request log

## Remote tools (home page)

- Kaizen: a short game. Name something to get better at, review your process, add one improvement, pick the smallest action you can do now, and download a summary card. Nothing typed is stored or sent.
- Draw: draw on the page with pens, straight lines, stamps and mirror mode; save the drawing as an image
- Kintsugi: tap the page to grow gold cracks
- Zen: a calm view of the page
- X-ray: shows the HTML and CSS behind each part of the page, in plain English
- Bot radar: the visits from the Bots page, drawn as a radar
- Terminal: the site as plain text, with commands (help, about, ping, uptime, bots)
